m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>As you walk up to the Xolotl Tower, the Umbra Legion guards make way for you. They seem to sense your mission of diplomacy. </ITALICS>
Ah, the Shaved Jaguar Cub interferes again! You are looking for the Shadow's Tongue? Hah. I guess that's me.
King Neza always did have a way with words. What message do you have for the Shadow Queen? Does he surrender?
What!? How dare you!?
The Shadow Queen will not like this news. I'll just have to strike you down to make sure I have something good to tell her!
Ay-yi-yi! That really hurts! I can't believe you did that! The Shadow Queen will heal me, and then you'll be sorry!
You did what to the Shadow's Tongue? <ITALICS>Huiya ohuaya! </ITALICS> You bring words sweet as honey!
What I would give to have seen that!
Outsider, Magician, I have another name for you. You are the Azure Shining One of song, who is destined to fight the Shadow.
You must never waver in this age-old battle, even when all seems bleak and forlorn.
Go and find the flower of beauty, my granddaughter Zenzen, and--
King Neza! And the young Wizard, of course. Who else would be sending tremors through my web?
Poor, loyal Yacate did not enjoy meeting you... but now it's time to let the grown-ups talk.
Neza, I need your royal blood to find the Pyramid of Mother Moon. Help me and I won't shred Alto Alto into a million splinters!
You are the heart of darkness. Your eyes are black holes, radiating pain. Your words are chittering insect sounds.
You are no friend of mine.
Your friend? What is this nonsense? I don't want to be your friend, I want you to grovel and beg to serve me!
Give me the secret, Grayfeather, or I'll ruin you and your whole family line!
Azure Shining One, find Zenzen and keep her safe! Ask Onyx Rain-Sun to show you the Head of the Sun! It can illuminate your way!
Shadow Queen, Daughter of Spiders, Mother of Lies, your time is done! <ITALICS>Ohuaya ohuaya!</ITALICS> The Feather Palace shall be our tomb! <ITALICS>Huiya!</ITALICS>
AHHHH!
An Outsider, I see, come from another world. <ITALICS>Ohuaya! Ohuaya! </ITALICS>
The Shadow's Tongue tries to speak, to say our flower, Zenzen, is in their grasp. They salivate to know the secret of Mother Moon.
Tell us, Outsider, is this true? Or is the Shadow as capricious and inconstant as the Pira'Nya Scissor Teeth?
The Lady Zenzen, the heart of song, is free and safe? You bring light to the dark places, Outsider!
Go to Xolotl, the tower that was lost, and find the Shadow's Tongue. Present our words like your own. Tell the Shadow's Tongue to fly...
...or be torn out!
By Mother Moon and all the stars in the Spiral!
